verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּרְא֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה עֵשָׂ֣ו בָּ֔א וְעִמּ֕וֹ אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וַיַּ֣חַץ אֶת־ הַיְלָדִ֗ים עַל־ לֵאָה֙ וְעַל־ רָחֵ֔ל וְעַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֥י הַשְּׁפָחֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā ya·‘ă·qōḇ ‘ê·nāw way·yar wə·hin·nêh ‘ê·śāw bā wə·‘im·mōw ’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ ’îš way·ya·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- hay·lā·ḏîm ‘al- lê·’āh wə·‘al- rā·ḥêl wə·‘al šə·tê haš·šə·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ
verses.literal: Now Jacob looked up . . . and saw . . . Esau coming toward him with four hundred men So he divided the children . . . among Leah . . . Rachel . . . and the two maidservants
verses.literalPt: Levantando Jacó os olhos, olhou, e eis que vinha Esaú, e com ele, quatrocentos homens. Repartiu, pois, os filhos entre Lia, Raquel e as duas servas.

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שֶׂם אֶת־ הַשְּׁפָח֛וֹת וְאֶת־ יַלְדֵיהֶ֖ן רִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְאֶת־ לֵאָ֤ה וִֽילָדֶ֙יהָ֙ אַחֲרֹנִ֔ים וְאֶת־ רָחֵ֥ל וְאֶת־ יוֹסֵ֖ף אַחֲרֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ’eṯ- haš·šə·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- yal·ḏê·hen ri·šō·nāh wə·’eṯ- lê·’āh wî·lā·ḏe·hā ’a·ḥă·rō·nîm wə·’eṯ- rā·ḥêl wə·’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ ’a·ḥă·rō·nîm
verses.literal: He put the maidservants and their children in front Leah and her children next and Rachel and Joseph at the rear
verses.literalPt: Pôs as servas e seus filhos na frente, a Lia e a seus filhos, atrás destes, e a Raquel e a José, por últimos.

verses.original: וְה֖וּא עָבַ֣ר לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֤חוּ אַ֙רְצָה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים עַד־ גִּשְׁתּ֖וֹ עַד־ אָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū ‘ā·ḇar lip̄·nê·hem way·yiš·ta·ḥū ’ar·ṣāh še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm ‘aḏ- giš·tōw ‘aḏ- ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: But Jacob himself went on ahead and bowed to the ground seven times as he approached . . . his brother
verses.literalPt: Ele mesmo passou adiante deles, e prostrou-se sete vezes, até chegar perto de seu irmão.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨רָץ עֵשָׂ֤ו לִקְרָאתוֹ֙ וַֽיְחַבְּקֵ֔הוּ וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל־ צַוָּארָ֖ו וַׄיִּׄשָּׁׄקֵ֑ׄהׄוּׄ וַיִּבְכּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rāṣ ‘ê·śāw liq·rā·ṯōw way·ḥab·bə·qê·hū way·yip·pōl ‘al- ṣaw·wå̄·rå̄w way·yiš·šå̄·qē·hū way·yiḇ·kū
verses.literal: Esau, however . . . ran to him and embraced him threw his arms around . . . his neck and kissed him And they both wept
verses.literalPt: Correu-lhe Esaú ao encontro, deu-lhe um abraço, lançou-se-lhe ao pescoço e o beijou; e eles choraram.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א אֶת־ עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּ֤רְא אֶת־ הַנָּשִׁים֙ וְאֶת־ הַיְלָדִ֔ים וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־ אֵ֣לֶּה לָּ֑ךְ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר הַיְלָדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁר־ חָנַ֥ן אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā ’eṯ- ‘ê·nāw way·yar ’eṯ- han·nā·šîm wə·’eṯ- hay·lā·ḏîm way·yō·mer mî- ’êl·leh lāḵ way·yō·mar hay·lā·ḏîm ’ă·šer- ḥā·nan ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: When Esau looked up - and saw the women and children he asked Who are these with you Jacob answered These are the children God has graciously given your servant
verses.literalPt: Levantando os olhos, viu as mulheres e meninos; e perguntou: Quem são estes? Respondeu-lhe Jacó: Os meninos que Deus, na sua bondade, deu a teu servo.

verses.original: וַתִּגַּ֧שְׁןָ הַשְּׁפָח֛וֹת הֵ֥נָּה וְיַלְדֵיהֶ֖ן וַתִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶֽיןָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tig·gaš·nā haš·šə·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ hên·nāh wə·yal·ḏê·hen wat·tiš·ta·ḥă·we·nā
verses.literal: Then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down
verses.literalPt: Então, se chegaram as servas, elas e seus filhos, e prostraram-se em terra.

verses.original: וַתִּגַּ֧שׁ גַּם־ לֵאָ֛ה וִילָדֶ֖יהָ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֑וּ וְאַחַ֗ר נִגַּ֥שׁ יוֹסֵ֛ף וְרָחֵ֖ל וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tig·gaš gam- lê·’āh wî·lā·ḏe·hā way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū wə·’a·ḥar nig·gaš yō·w·sêp̄ wə·rā·ḥêl way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū
verses.literal: Leah and her children also approached and bowed down and then Joseph and Rachel approached and bowed down
verses.literalPt: Chegaram-se também Lia e seus filhos e prostraram-se; depois, chegaram-se José e Raquel e prostraram-se.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י לְךָ֛ כָּל־ הַמַּחֲנֶ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּגָ֑שְׁתִּי וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לִמְצֹא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mî lə·ḵā kāl- ham·ma·ḥă·neh haz·zeh ’ă·šer pā·ḡā·šə·tî way·yō·mer lim·ṣō- ḥên bə·‘ê·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: What do you mean by sending this whole company to meet me asked Esau To find favor in your sight my lord Jacob answered
verses.literalPt: Perguntou Esaú: Qual é a tua intenção em todos estes bandos que encontrei? Respondeu Jacó: Para achar graça diante do meu senhor.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר עֵשָׂ֖ו יֶשׁ־ לִ֣י רָ֑ב אָחִ֕י יְהִ֥י לְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁר־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘ê·śāw yeš- lî rāḇ ’ā·ḥî yə·hî lə·ḵā ’ă·šer- lāḵ
verses.literal: I already have plenty my brother Esau replied Keep what belongs to you
verses.literalPt: Mas Esaú disse: Tenho bastante, meu irmão; fica com o que tens.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב אַל־ נָא֙ אִם־ נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ מִנְחָתִ֖י מִיָּדִ֑י כִּ֣י עַל־ כֵּ֞ן רָאִ֣יתִי פָנֶ֗יךָ כִּרְאֹ֛ת פְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַתִּרְצֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’al- nā ’im- nā mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā wə·lā·qaḥ·tā min·ḥā·ṯî mî·yā·ḏî kî ‘al- kên rā·’î·ṯî p̄ā·ne·ḵā kir·’ōṯ pə·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wat·tir·ṣê·nî
verses.literal: But Jacob insisted No please If . . . I have found favor in your sight then receive this gift from my hand For . . . indeed I have seen your face and it is like seeing the face of God since you have received me favorably
verses.literalPt: Replicou-lhe Jacó: Não recuses; se agora achei graça diante de ti, recebe o presente da minha mão; porque vi o teu rosto como quem vê o rosto de Deus; e tu te agradaste de mim.

verses.original: קַח־ נָ֤א אֶת־ בִּרְכָתִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֻבָ֣את לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־ חַנַּ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְכִ֣י יֶשׁ־ לִי־ כֹ֑ל וַיִּפְצַר־ בּ֖וֹ וַיִּקָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: qaḥ- nā ’eṯ- bir·ḵā·ṯî ’ă·šer hu·ḇāṯ lāḵ kî- ḥan·na·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ḵî yeš- lî- ḵōl way·yip̄·ṣar- bōw way·yiq·qāḥ
verses.literal: Please accept my gift that was brought to you because God . . . has been gracious to me and I have all I need So Jacob pressed him until he accepted
verses.literalPt: Recebe o meu presente que eu te trouxe; porque Deus tem sido bondoso para comigo, e porque tenho bastante. Insistiu com ele, e ele o recebeu.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר נִסְעָ֣ה וְנֵלֵ֑כָה וְאֵלְכָ֖ה לְנֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer nis·‘āh wə·nê·lê·ḵāh wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh lə·neḡ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Esau said Let us be on our way . . . and I will go ahead of you
verses.literalPt: Então, Esaú disse: Ponhamo-nos a caminho e vamo-nos, eu irei adiante de ti.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אֲדֹנִ֤י יֹדֵ֙עַ֙ כִּֽי־ הַיְלָדִ֣ים רַכִּ֔ים וְהַצֹּ֥אן וְהַבָּקָ֖ר עָל֣וֹת עָלָ֑י וּדְפָקוּם֙ י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וָמֵ֖תוּ כָּל־ הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ă·ḏō·nî yō·ḏê·a‘ kî- hay·lā·ḏîm rak·kîm wə·haṣ·ṣōn wə·hab·bā·qār ‘ā·lō·wṯ ‘ā·lāy ū·ḏə·p̄ā·qūm yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ wā·mê·ṯū kāl- haṣ·ṣōn
verses.literal: But Jacob replied . . . My lord knows that the children are frail and I must care for sheep and cattle that are nursing their young If they are driven hard for even a day all the animals will die
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jacó: Meu senhor sabe que os meninos são tenros e que tenho de cuidar das ovelhas e das vacas que têm crias; se forem obrigadas a caminhar demais um só dia, morrerão todos os rebanhos.

verses.original: יַעֲבָר־ נָ֥א אֲדֹנִ֖י לִפְנֵ֣י עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַאֲנִ֞י אֶֽתְנָהֲלָ֣ה לְאִטִּ֗י לְרֶ֨גֶל הַמְּלָאכָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ לְפָנַי֙ וּלְרֶ֣גֶל הַיְלָדִ֔ים עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־ אָבֹ֥א אֶל־ אֲדֹנִ֖י שֵׂעִֽירָה׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·ḇār- nā ’ă·ḏō·nî lip̄·nê ‘aḇ·dōw wa·’ă·nî ’eṯ·nā·hă·lāh lə·’iṭ·ṭî lə·re·ḡel ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ’ă·šer- lə·p̄ā·nay ū·lə·re·ḡel hay·lā·ḏîm ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- ’ā·ḇō ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nî śê·‘î·rāh
verses.literal: Please let my lord go ahead of his servant I will continue on slowly at a comfortable pace - . . . for the livestock and children until I come to my lord at Seir
verses.literalPt: Passe meu senhor adiante de seu servo; eu seguirei, guiando-as mansamente, conforme o passo do gado que está adiante de mim e conforme o passo dos meninos, até chegar à casa de meu senhor, em Seir.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו אַצִּֽיגָה־ נָּ֣א עִמְּךָ֔ מִן־ הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֑י וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לָ֣מָּה זֶּ֔ה אֶמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘ê·śāw ’aṣ·ṣî·ḡāh- nā ‘im·mə·ḵā min- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’it·tî way·yō·mer lām·māh zeh ’em·ṣā- ḥên bə·‘ê·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: Let me leave . . . some of my . . . people with you Esau said But Jacob replied Why do that Let me find favor in the sight of my lord
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Esaú: Permite que eu deixe contigo da gente que está comigo. Disse Jacó: Para quê? Que ache eu graça aos olhos de meu senhor.

verses.original: וַיָּשָׁב֩ בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֛ו לְדַרְכּ֖וֹ שֵׂעִֽירָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ bay·yō·wm ha·hū ‘ê·śāw lə·ḏar·kōw śê·‘î·rāh
verses.literal: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir
verses.literalPt: Assim, voltou Esaú aquele dia seu caminho para Seir.

verses.original: וְיַעֲקֹב֙ נָסַ֣ע סֻכֹּ֔תָה וַיִּ֥בֶן ל֖וֹ בָּ֑יִת וּלְמִקְנֵ֙הוּ֙ עָשָׂ֣ה סֻכֹּ֔ת עַל־ כֵּ֛ן קָרָ֥א שֵׁם־ הַמָּק֖וֹם סֻכּֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ nā·sa‘ suk·kō·ṯāh way·yi·ḇen lōw bā·yiṯ ū·lə·miq·nê·hū ‘ā·śāh suk·kōṯ ‘al- kên qā·rā šêm- ham·mā·qō·wm suk·kō·wṯ
verses.literal: but Jacob went on to Succoth where he built a house for himself and shelters for his livestock . . . that is why . . . the place was called . . . Succoth
verses.literalPt: Jacó partiu para Sucote, e edificou para si uma casa, e fez barracas para o seu gado; por isso, o lugar se chama Sucote.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֩ יַעֲקֹ֨ב שָׁלֵ֜ם עִ֣יר שְׁכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בְּבֹא֖וֹ מִפַּדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם וַיִּ֖חַן אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ya·‘ă·qōḇ šā·lêm ‘îr šə·ḵem ’ă·šer bə·’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an bə·ḇō·’ōw mip·pad·dan ’ă·rām way·yi·ḥan ’eṯ- pə·nê hā·‘îr
verses.literal: After Jacob had come from Paddan-aram he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan and he camped . . . just outside the city
verses.literalPt: Chegou Jacó são e salvo à cidade de Siquém, que está na terra de Canaã, quando voltou de Padã-Arã; e armou a sua tenda diante da cidade.

verses.original: וַיִּ֜קֶן אֶת־ חֶלְקַ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽטָה־ שָׁם֙ אָהֳל֔וֹ מִיַּ֥ד בְּנֵֽי־ חֲמ֖וֹר אֲבִ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם בְּמֵאָ֖ה קְשִׂיטָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·qen ’eṯ- ḥel·qaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ’ă·šer nā·ṭāh- šām ’ā·ho·lōw mî·yaḏ bə·nê- ḥă·mō·wr ’ă·ḇî šə·ḵem bə·mê·’āh qə·śî·ṭāh
verses.literal: And the plot of ground where he pitched . . . his tent he purchased from the sons of Hamor Shechem’s father for a hundred pieces of silver
verses.literalPt: A parte do campo em que armara a sua tenda, comprou-a ele dos filhos de Hamor, pai de Siquém, por cem peças de dinheiro.

verses.original: וַיַּצֶּב־ שָׁ֖ם מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּ֨קְרָא־ ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yaṣ·ṣeḇ- šām miz·bê·aḥ way·yiq·rā- lōw ’êl ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: There he set up an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Levantou ali um altar e chamou-lhe El-Elohe-Israel.
